recent_en: PHB is pursuing several corporate exercises, including a 100-to-1 share consolidation, a 3-for-1 rights issue with warrants, diversification into property development, and an ESOS, alongside a proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares. The company also plans to acquire Titijaya's Penang logistics hub for RM300 million and develop a RM98 million project in Port Dickson.
notable_en: Proposed 100-to-1 share consolidation and proposed 3-for-1 rights issue with warrants at RM0.15 per rights share and RM0.22 per warrant exercise price.
Proposed diversification into property development and proposed establishment of an ESOS of up to 15% of issued shares.
Proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares to third-party investors.
risks_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Proposed rights issue of up to 324.6 million new shares with up to 216.4 million warrants may dilute existing shareholders.
Proposed 100-to-1 share consolidation will reduce the number of shares and may affect price volatility.
